method: Compared fishing and park lists with boat launches, water trails, manager properties and geographic access inventories. Merged aliases, kept distinct access points, checked usable bank routes and recorded specific exclusions. Route screening does not prove public access.
limitations: The inventory is a systematic coverage review. It cannot establish every informal shoreline or future opening. Deferred candidates retain a concrete unresolved question for later review; old reasoning must be reconsidered.

sourceInventories.name: Regional manager, fishery and advisory inventories
sourceInventories.note: Individual candidate records retain the county, city, port, utility, federal, state, fishing and health sources actually checked.

counts.note: Candidate decisions include aliases and repeated regional leads; totalLocations counts distinct mapped access records.

candidates.name: North Fork Lewis · Cedar Creek launch bank

The nearby Lewis River Hatchery entry is on the opposite north bank with a different road approach and no pedestrian crossing between the two.

candidates.name: North Fork Lewis · Lewis River Hatchery bank
